notes.title: Update of July 27th
notes.notes:
Today, Door To Door will be getting its last major content update.

This update includes:
1.) New Case-File; "Knew A Guy Once" Finale
2.) New Location; "Jazztown"
3.) New Location; "Tertiary"
4.) 4k Resolution support

It is with immense relief and excitement that I give you the end to Bixby and Stiggz's story inside the Ministry Of Order. Over the past two and a half years, the Lounge District became my second home. I'm really going to miss this place. Words cannot describe the satisfaction I have gotten from the chance to share this experience with you all.

Let's reflect... We've seen dogs with shoes, rode in a pie-mobile, been under the influence of low-frequency-corn-syrup, shut down a conspiracy installing machine, explored a galactic alien ministry, witnessed the downsides of show-business, was lifted into an enormous synth-tower, the list goes on. And now we're here, at the light of the end of the tunnel.

The past six plus months of thirty-day deadlines has really been an absolutely exhausting experience. And it is just about over.

IMPORTANT INFORMATION:

*Door To Door will be looking into English subtitle support in the coming future. Other languages are currently being considered.

*Door To Door will transition from Early Access to Full Release following English subtitle support.

*Door To Door's price from Early Access to Full Release will transition from $6.99USD to $7.99USD.

*No date has been specified for subtitle support, an announcement for an update will come before it is released.

*The Early Access info on the Steam page will change once today's update is published.

Thank you all for your generosity in both support and patience throughout Door To Door's production!

- Casey

notes.title: Regarding the June Update
notes.notes:
I'd like to take a few moments to inform the whereabouts and expectancy of this month's update. Where is it and when should you expect it?

Major content updates have mostly been consistent throughout each month, occurring at the ends of each month. This specific Case-File; "The Synthman Cometh", may arrive a few days late, possibly leaking a little while into the next month.

To give you a better idea on what has happened; there is quite literally a single bug that needs figuring out. This bug occurs toward the end of the approximate thirty-minute+ experience. This of course, is not acceptable to release. However, I can only test so much as an individual, so I will be needing to test this Case-File further to be completely sure.

When should you expect it? Soon. If there is not an additional post tonight or tomorrow announcing it, it will of leaked into this coming month of July.

This Case-File is an important factor in the game's story. It pains me to have that need to delay it further, but I will if I must.

Thank you all so much for sticking with Door To Door. I'm sure you'll be experiencing "Diabolical Jazz" really soon!

- Casey

notes.title: The April Update + CONTEST + More
notes.notes:
Today, April 29th, Door To Door will be updated.

This update includes;
1.) New Case-File to play - "It Came From Ministry X!"
2.) New Location - "Ministry X"
3.) New Location - "Plutonium Pizza"
4.) +1 New "Playable Radio"
6.) Changed colors of the "FollowVision" Machine legend and generators for better visual clarification

7.) Added blocking volume behind "Elevator" from Upper Tulip Elevator to Reef Lounge to ensure player does not get stuck

8.) Widened button interaction radius for both "Charizmo Stations" and "History Machines", as well as decreased their interaction cool-downs

9.) Environmental Polish & Optimization

*Special thanks to user "Spade" for finding the elevator bug.

*Any fussy button interactions that have been reported are rare. For the users whom have experiences this, hopefully this update did something. Fixing this problem has not been a priority due to how rare the reports have been.

- - - CONTEST INFORMATION - - -

*This contest will be effective immediately when the game is updated.

*What you will have to find: Located within Ministry X, there will be ONE HIDDEN GOLDEN SPACESHIP. It is small in size, approximately handheld such as a collectible figure.

*What you will have to do: You will need to post a single, clear screenshot of this golden spaceship and publish it to the Community Hub.

*Whomever is the FIRST to publish their finding will win the contest.

*What you will receive: I will be contacting the winner via Steam message personally to give them THREE{3} product keys for Door To Door.

- - - BONUS STUFF - - -

I realize these are not actually functioning Steam Guides, but I've made albums for the Playable Radios and Matter Fact Machines. I didn't want to take anyone's creativity away if they wished to create any guides... That's my excuse and I'm sticking by it. ;)

Playable Radio Guide: https://imgur.com/a/1dIdg

Matter Fact Machine Guide: https://imgur.com/a/0L7iI

- - - MORE - - -

The reason I'm putting this all the way down here is because I'm not sure if I'm breaking any rules by doing so. Anyway...

DOOR TO DOOR SHIRTS!:
http://www.redbubble.com/people/cdjones/works/21611817-head-blast

notes.title: The March Interactivity Update
notes.notes:
Today, Door To Door will be getting an update.

This Update Includes;

1.)New Case-File to play “Follow-Vision” 
2.)New explorable location; “Interior Solutions” 
3.)7 Audio Diaries/Playable Radios to find 
4.)Quick Interaction with simple, static NPC agents 
6.)New robotic machine character to interact with; “Matter Fact with Sam Melon”(5 part series) 
7.)Environmental polish and optimization
8.)Gamma Correction in Options Menu
9.)New Loading Screen/Main Menu click sounds

I am very sorry for the delay for this update, but it was just not possible to fit into a single month. However, it is here now.

You "may" see some minor updates within the next few weeks that will include additional interaction as well as an additional Playable Radio to find. If not, they'll be included in the next major update.

Updates for Drawer 2 are going to be fewer and farther between as previously stated. It is in my best interest to have these new updates in as best quality as I possibly can.

Please let me know if you'd like for me to post a guide to all Playable Radios and Sam Melon machines.

Have fun!

notes.title: February Update Postponed
notes.notes:
Door To Door will not be getting a February update. Hold tight, this isn't bad news! Nothing terrible has happened, but only great things have. However, due to a complicating schedule, pushing the update for this month won't be possible.

This March, Door To Door will be getting a BIG update called “The Interactivity Update”. Something that I've been noting from players is their 'desire' to explore the Lounge District while on the case. While this option has always been there, there was never enough to interact with, to study from this interaction besides the History Machines and poster propaganda.

Here are the details that will cover the launch of Drawer 2:

1.)New Case-File to play “Follow-Vision”
2.)New explorable location; “Interior Solutions”
3.)Audio Diaries/Playable Radios to find
4.)Quick Interaction with simple, static NPC agents
6.)New robotic machine character to interact with; “Matter Fact with Sam Melon”(5 part series)
7.)Environmental polish and optimization
	
Drawer 2 will be integrated precisely the same as Drawer 1, meaning one case at a time. The game will work the same as it did just before. All that will be changing is simply update time-frames.

This update is important but still needs time, and it will not launch until it's ready. You will all of course be notified before it does. This update will also be exclusive to that numbered list. Since this was the focal-point of development, nothing else has been pushed to fit into it.

With all that being said, I think it's safe to say Drawer 2 is going to be a very interesting ride. What's in store may take a fair bit longer, but should also be worth the wait and keep things delightfully refreshing.

Thank you all. I look forward to sharing this new experience!

Be sure to take a look at this album for reference for the update. No photos of "Interior Solutions" will be shown to avoid spoilers.

https://imgur.com/a/dYCgR

@BestMilkshake

notes.title: Update Of January 29th
notes.notes:
Today, January 29th, Door To Door will be updated.

Update Includes:

1.) New Case-File; "Bad Photography"

2.) Location "Autumn Fall" converted into "The Schultz".

3.) Options support for mouse "Invert Y Axis".

4.) Various Environmental Polish


Some of you brought up the desire for 'left handed control support'. This update does NOT include this. This I understand is a notable thing that can be patched in the future. If you have already modified the .ini that lists your controls, please save that document and replace it over the identical .ini that this update will overwrite. This update will revert your controls if you do not do so.

If you are left handed, please do supply me with your preferred key layout in a new discussion topic within the Discussions. This will be a big help and can also ensure that in the future, this layout could automatically be supported in-game without having to re-bind.

Thanks!

notes.title: Upcoming Update of Nov. 30th
notes.notes:
Tomorrow, Nov. 30th, Door To Door will be getting an update.

"What is involved in this update?"
Having viewed some of your feedback, an issue worth noting is that players are easily becoming overwhelmed or non-directed by the environment. It was important for me to gauge what kind of player direction was needed, now well knowing you'd like a little more. Directing a player without being intrusive is difficult, reaching for multiple methods in this direction to where it feels smooth is the question.

Tomorrow's update will include:

1.) A renewed "Dogs With Shoes" Case-File to behave as the introduction to both bring light of world information and how to approach Case-Files.

2.) Objective Arrows will hover over current player objective points. This will still require the player to study their environment.

I am unsure at what exact time the update will go live. My timezone is EST.

Thank you all for your feedback.
